newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBM Japan, regional banks to test Internet commerce.
newsitem.headline: IBM Japan, regional banks to test Internet commerce.

text.p: IBM Japan Ltd, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, said on Thursday that it and a group of Japanese regional banks would begin trials of electronic commerce on the Internet as early as October.
Account holders at the regional banks will be able to buy goods through the Internet's on-line shopping mall and settle payments through the Internet, IBM Japan said.
A total of eight regional banks, including Ashikaga Bank Ltd and Juroku Bank, have so far decided to participate in the project and more banks are expected to join, IBM said.
IBM Japan said it will be the first time for Japan's regional banks to take part in on-line commerce.
